original_benchmark.notes: ArtificialAnalysis/ITBench-AA, sre domain, public split: 40 of 59 total scenarios released (the rest held out). Same file-tree layout/ground-truth schema as ibm-research/ITBench-Lite (Scenario-N/{alerts,metrics,*_raw.tsv,ground_truth.yaml}), built in partnership with IBM. CC-BY-4.0.

harbor_adapter.notes: Only Scenario-1 has been downloaded/generated/verified so far (sample validation); the adapter dynamically enumerates whatever Scenario-N directories are present under sre/ (or under snapshots/sre/<version>/ as a fallback), no scenario count is hardcoded. Oracle scores reward=1.0 on the one generated task. Update adapted_benchmark_size as more of the public 40 are downloaded and generated. Answer schema is single-cause (root_cause/kind/namespace/reasoning/propagation_chain), same as adapters/itbench-lite -- see that adapter's WHATS_NEXT.md for the deferred entities[] schema migration, which is out of scope here.
